create_entity_hierarchy: create a scene hierarchy by adding parent and child entities with Vector3 positions using AI4Animation.Scene.AddEntity
create_cube_primitive: create a cube primitive in the scene using AI4Animation.Standalone.Primitives.CreateCube with a name and position
create_sphere_primitive: create a sphere primitive in the scene using AI4Animation.Standalone.Primitives.CreateSphere with a name and position
add_custom_component: add a custom Component subclass to an entity using AddComponent with amplitude and frequency parameters
run_standalone_animation: run an AI4Animation program in STANDALONE mode by passing a Program instance to AI4Animation with mode parameter
